title: Decision: Attendance and Participation by Non-Signatory States at the Twenty-Ninth Session of the Conference of the States Parties
text:
CS-2024-4980(E) distributed 27/11/2024 
*CS-2024-4980.E* 
 
 
OPCW 
Conference of the States Parties 
Twenty-Ninth Session 
25 – 29 November 2024 
 
C-29/DEC.1 
25 November 2024 
Original: ENGLISH 
 
DECISION 
ATTENDANCE AND PARTICIPATION BY NON-SIGNATORY STATES AT THE 
TWENTY-NINTH SESSION OF THE CONFERENCE OF THE STATES PARTIES 
The Conference of the States Parties, 
 
Bearing in mind Rule 30 of its Rules of Procedure, 
 
Hereby: 
 
Extends observer status to South Sudan—a State that has neither signed the Chemical 
Weapons Convention nor acceded to it—at the Twenty-Ninth Session of the Conference of the 
States Parties.
